title: Preserving Foundational Capabilities in Flow-Matching VLAs through Conservative SFT
summary: Unconstrained fine-tuning of flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models drives dense parameter overwrites, degrading pre-trained capabilities. We present Conservative Supervised Fine-Tuning (ConSFT), an optimization objective that adapts to target distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, requiring zero prior data or architectural overhead. By dynamically scaling learning signals based on model confidence, ConSFT suppresses excessive gradients from low-confidence samples to prevent disproportionate parameter updates, thereby bounding the intrinsic parameter disruption risk. Inspired by reinforcement learning's trust-region clipping, this formulation establishes a progressive learning dynamic to secure target convergence and prior capability retention, maintaining sparse parameter updates without relying on the parallel reference networks required by explicit regularization. We evaluate ConSFT on the LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks across state-of-the-art flow-matching VLAs ($π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T-N1.6-3B). The method outperforms vanilla SFT in capability retention by an average absolute margin of over 20\%, matching the efficacy of data-heavy Experience Replay in a prior-data-free regime. Real-world robotic deployments confirm that ConSFT precludes spatial overfitting during downstream adaptation, preserving pre-trained physical skills while acquiring sequential target tasks.
tldr: The paper proposes Conservative Supervised Fine-Tuning (ConSFT), a method to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in flow-matching Vision-Language-Action models during fine-tuning, preserving foundational capabilities without prior data or architectural changes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种保守的监督微调方法（ConSFT），用于缓解流匹配视觉语言动作模型在微调时的灾难性遗忘，无需先验数据或架构改动即可保持基础能力。
summary_zh: 流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型的无约束微调会导致密集参数覆盖，削弱预训练能力。本文提出保守监督微调，这是一种优化目标，能在适应目标分布的同时缓解灾难性遗忘，且无需先验数据或额外架构开销。该方法通过基于模型置信度动态调整学习信号，抑制低置信度样本产生的过度梯度，从而避免参数更新失衡，从本质上限制参数扰动风险。受强化学习中信赖域裁剪的启发，该设计建立了渐进式学习动态机制，确保目标收敛性与先验能力保留，在不依赖显式正则化所需并行参考网络的前提下维持稀疏参数更新。我们在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准测试中对前沿流匹配VLA模型进行实验验证。结果表明，该方法在能力保留方面平均超越基础监督微调超过20%，在无先验数据场景下达到了数据密集型经验回放方法的效果。实际机器人部署证实，保守监督微调能避免下游适应过程中的空间过拟合，在习得序列目标任务的同时保持预训练的物理技能。

title: Constraint-Aware Diffusion Priors for High-Fidelity and Versatile Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Reinforcement learning combined with imitation learning has significantly advanced biomimetic quadrupedal locomotion. However, scaling these frameworks to massive, multi-source datasets exposes fundamental bottlenecks. First, traditional GAN-based discriminators are prone to mode collapse, struggling to capture diverse motion distributions from uncurated datasets. Second, existing kinematic priors suffer from out-of-distribution (OOD) tracking conflicts, leading to severe unintended heading drifts during complex maneuvers. Furthermore, deploying unconstrained priors to physical hardware poses critical safety risks by disregarding actuator dynamics. To overcome these challenges, we propose Diff-CAST (Diffusion-guided Constraint-Aware Symmetric Tracking), a novel motion prior framework leveraging the multi-modal distribution modeling capabilities of diffusion models for stylistic rewards. Diff-CAST effectively replaces traditional GAN discriminators, unlocking robust data scaling on heterogeneous collections. To ensure high-fidelity intent execution and reliable real-world deployment, we introduce a comprehensive Sim2Re architecture integrating Symmetric Augmented Command Conditioning (SACC) for drift-free tracking, and Constrained RL for hardware safety. Experiments on a quadruped demonstrate that Diff-CAST mitigates mode collapse, enables seamless transitions between diverse skills, and ensures robust, hardware-compliant locomotion.
tldr: Proposes Diff-CAST, a diffusion-based motion prior for quadruped locomotion that replaces GAN discriminators to avoid mode collapse, and integrates constraint-aware RL for high-fidelity and hardware-safe tracking.
tldr_zh: 提出Diff-CAST，一种用于四足机器人运动的扩散模型先验，替代GAN判别器以避免模式崩溃，并集成约束感知强化学习以实现高保真度和硬件安全的运动跟踪。
summary_zh: 强化学习与模仿学习相结合，显著推动了仿生四足运动的发展。然而，将这些框架扩展到大规模、多来源的数据集时，暴露了根本性的瓶颈。首先，传统的基于生成对抗网络的判别器容易陷入模式崩溃，难以从未经筛选的数据集中捕捉多样化的运动分布。其次，现有的运动学先验方法存在分布外跟踪冲突问题，导致在复杂机动动作中产生严重的非预期航向漂移。此外，将无约束先验部署到物理硬件上时，由于未考虑执行器动力学特性，会带来关键的安全风险。为克服这些挑战，我们提出Diff-CAST（扩散引导的约束感知对称跟踪框架），这是一种新型运动先验框架，利用扩散模型的多模态分布建模能力实现风格化奖励生成。Diff-CAST有效替代了传统生成对抗网络判别器，在异构数据集合上实现了稳健的数据扩展。为确保高保真意图执行和可靠的现实世界部署，我们构建了完整的Sim2Re架构，集成对称增强指令条件机制以实现无漂移跟踪，并采用约束强化学习保障硬件安全。在四足机器人上的实验表明，Diff-CAST能够缓解模式崩溃，实现多样化技能间的无缝切换，并确保稳定、符合硬件规范的运动性能。

title: ProcVLM: Learning Procedure-Grounded Progress Rewards for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires dense feedback that reflects how a task advances through its procedural stages, not merely whether the final outcome is successful. Existing reward models often rely on trajectory-level success labels or time-based interpolation, which can conflate elapsed time with true task progress and therefore fail to capture unfinished steps, stagnation, and failure states. We present ProcVLM, a progress-aware vision-language model that learns procedure-grounded progress as a dense reward signal for manipulation. Rather than deriving progress from terminal outcomes or temporal proxies, ProcVLM grounds progress estimation in procedural structure and intra-stage visual change, and further adopts a reasoning-before-estimation paradigm that infers the remaining atomic actions before estimating task progress. Specifically, we construct this supervision by synthesizing frame-level subtask-semantic annotations, assigning progress budgets according to subtask structure, and distributing each budget based on intra-subtask visual change. To train ProcVLM at scale, we build a standardized procedural supervision synthesis pipeline and construct ProcCorpus-60M from 30 embodied datasets with 60M annotated frames, from which we derive ProcVQA for procedure-aware pretraining, with progress estimation as the central task alongside action segmentation and future planning. Experiments on ProcVQA and reward-model benchmarks show that ProcVLM improves embodied procedural reasoning and yields more discriminative trajectory-internal progress estimates than representative baselines, supporting its use as a dense reward model for downstream reward-guided policy optimization. Project page: https://procvlm.github.io/
tldr: ProcVLM learns procedure-grounded progress rewards for robotic manipulation by synthesizing subtask-semantic annotations and adopting a reasoning-before-estimation paradigm, improving dense reward signals for policy optimization.
tldr_zh: ProcVLM通过合成子任务语义注释并采用推理先于估计的范式，学习面向过程的进度奖励用于机器人操作，从而改善策略优化的密集奖励信号。
summary_zh: 长期机器人操作需要密集的反馈来反映任务在流程各阶段的推进情况，而不仅限于最终结果是否成功。现有的奖励模型通常依赖于轨迹级别的成功标签或基于时间轴的插值方法，这可能将已用时间与真实任务进展混淆，因此无法捕捉未完成的步骤、停滞状态和失败状态。我们提出ProcVLM模型——一个能感知进程的视觉语言模型，它通过学习基于操作流程的进展信息，生成密集的奖励信号。不同于从最终结果或时间代理变量推导进展，ProcVLM将进展评估建立在流程结构和阶段内视觉变化的基础上，并采用“先推理后评估”范式，即在估计任务进展前先推断剩余原子动作。具体而言，我们通过合成帧级别的子任务语义标注、依据子任务结构分配进展预算，并根据子任务内视觉变化分配各阶段预算来构建监督信息。为大规模训练ProcVLM，我们构建了标准化的流程监督合成流水线，从30个具身数据集中构建了包含6000万标注帧的ProcCorpus-60M数据集，并由此衍生出面向流程感知预训练的ProcVQA数据集，其中将进展估计作为核心任务，同时包含动作分割和未来规划任务。在ProcVQA和奖励模型基准测试上的实验表明，ProcVLM显著提升了具身流程推理能力，并产生比代表性基线模型更具区分度的轨迹内部进展估计，这支持了其作为密集奖励模型应用于下游奖励引导策略优化的可行性。项目页面：https://procvlm.github.io/

title: REAP: Reinforcement-Learning End-to-End Autonomous Parking with Gaussian Splatting Simulator for Real2Sim2Real Transfer
summary: In recent years, autonomous parking has made significant advances, yet parking tasks still face challenges in extreme scenarios such as mechanical and dead-end parking slots, often resulting in failures. This is mainly due to traditional parking methods adopting a multistage approach, lacking the ability to optimize the parking problem as a whole. End-to-end methods enable joint optimization across perception and planning modules to eliminate the accumulation of errors, enhancing algorithm performance in extreme scenarios. Although several end-to-end parking methods use imitation or reinforcement learning, the former is limited by data cost and distribution coverage, while the latter suffers from inefficient exploration. To address these challenges, we propose a Reinforcement learning End-to-end Autonomous Parking method (REAP). REAP employs Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) within an asymmetric reinforcement learning framework to improve training efficiency and inference performance. To accelerate model convergence, we distill the capabilities of a rule-based planner into the end-to-end network through behavior cloning. We further introduce a soft predictive collision penalty mechanism to reduce collision rates by penalizing obstacle-approaching actions. To ensure that the trained reinforcement learning network can directly transfer to real-world scenarios, we have established a Real2Sim2Real simulator. In the Real2Sim step, we use 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to transform real-world scenes into digital scenes. In the Sim2Real step, we deploy the end-to-end model onto the vehicle to bridge the Sim2Real gap. Trained in the 3DGS simulator and deployed on physical vehicles, REAP successfully parks in various types of parking spaces, especially demonstrating the feasibility of end-to-end RL parking in extremely narrow mechanical slots.
tldr: The paper proposes REAP, a reinforcement learning end-to-end autonomous parking method that uses a Gaussian Splatting simulator for real2sim2real transfer, demonstrating successful deployment on physical vehicles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出REAP，一种强化学习端到端自主停车方法，使用高斯泼溅模拟器进行真实到模拟再到真实的数据迁移，并在实体车辆上成功部署。
summary_zh: 近年来，自主泊车技术取得了显著进展，但在机械式泊车等极端场景中仍面临挑战，易导致任务失败。这主要是由于传统泊车方法采用多阶段处理策略，缺乏对泊车问题进行整体优化的能力。端到端方法通过联合优化感知与规划模块，可消除误差累积，提升算法在极端场景下的性能。尽管已有部分端到端泊车方法采用模仿学习或强化学习，但前者受限于数据成本与分布覆盖范围，后者则存在探索效率低的问题。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的端到端自主泊车方法（REAP）。该方法在非对称强化学习框架中采用柔性演员-评论家算法，以提高训练效率和推理性能。为加速模型收敛，我们通过行为克隆将基于规则的规划器能力蒸馏至端到端网络中。此外，我们引入了柔性预测碰撞惩罚机制，通过惩罚接近障碍物的行为来降低碰撞率。为确保训练后的强化学习网络能直接迁移至真实场景，我们构建了Real2Sim2Real仿真系统。在Real2Sim阶段，我们使用三维高斯溅射技术将真实场景转化为数字场景；在Sim2Real阶段，我们将端到端模型部署至实车以弥合仿真与现实的差距。通过在三维高斯溅射仿真环境中训练并部署于实体车辆，REAP成功实现了多种类型泊车位的自主泊车，尤其在极端狭窄的机械式车位中验证了端到端强化学习泊车方案的可行性。

title: Geometry Guided Self-Consistency for Physical AI
summary: State-of-the-art physical AI models generate a chunk of actions per inference through diffusion or flow matching, iteratively refining an initial noise sample into an action trajectory. Because this inference process is inherently stochastic, committing to a single trajectory per round is brittle, and this brittleness compounds across the many sequential rounds that comprise a complete episode. We introduce KeyStone, an inference-time self-consistency method for diffusion-based action generation that draws $K$ candidate action chunks in parallel from a shared model context, clusters them in continuous action space, and returns the medoid of the largest cluster -- no additional model required. Two properties make this practical. First, the compact nature of action trajectories makes diffusion inference memory-bandwidth bound, leaving spare compute capacity to run $K$ chains in parallel with no additional wall-clock latency. Second, unlike token or pixel spaces where distance carries no semantic meaning and selection requires a learned judge, action chunks are geometrically structured such that Euclidean distance directly reflects physical similarity, making selection principled and judge-free. Across diverse vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs), KeyStone improves task success rates by up to \textbf{13.3\%} over single-trajectory sampling with negligible latency overhead, while having on par accuracy with model-based selectors at no training cost. We open source KeyStone at https://github.com/dywsjtu/keystone.
tldr: KeyStone is a self-consistency method for diffusion-based action generation that clusters K parallel candidate trajectories in continuous action space and selects the medoid of the largest cluster, improving task success rates for VLA and world-action models with minimal latency.
tldr_zh: KeyStone 是一种用于扩散动作生成的推理时自一致性方法，它在连续动作空间中并行采样 K 个候选轨迹并聚类，选择最大簇的质心，以最小延迟提升了 VLA 和世界动作模型的任务成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：
最先进的物理人工智能模型通过扩散或流匹配方法生成一系列动作片段，将初始噪声样本迭代优化为动作轨迹。由于该推理过程具有固有的随机性，每轮仅生成单一轨迹的做法较为脆弱，且这种脆弱性会在构成完整场景的多个连续轮次中不断累积。本文提出KeyStone——一种基于扩散动作生成的推理时自一致性方法，该方法从共享模型上下文中并行抽取$K$个候选动作片段，在连续动作空间中进行聚类，并返回最大簇的中位点，整个过程无需额外模型支持。其可行性源于两大特性：首先，动作轨迹的紧凑性使得扩散推理受限于内存带宽，从而可利用空闲计算能力并行运行$K$条推理链而不增加实际时延；其次，与缺乏语义距离度量的标记或像素空间不同，动作片段具有几何结构特性，欧氏距离可直接反映物理相似度，使得选择过程具有原则性且无需训练判别器。在多种视觉语言动作模型（VLA）与世界动作模型（WAM）中，KeyStone在可忽略的时延开销下将任务成功率较单轨迹采样提升最高达\textbf{13.3\%}，同时与基于模型的选择器保持相当的准确率且无需训练成本。我们在https://github.com/dywsjtu/keystone开源了KeyStone。

title: BEACON: Cross-Domain Co-Training of Generative Robot Policies via Best-Effort Adaptation
summary: We introduce BEACON--Best-Effort Adaptation for Cross-Domain Co-Training--a theory-driven framework for training generative robot policies with abundant source demonstrations and limited target demonstrations. BEACON casts cross-domain co-training as a discrepancy-aware importance-reweighting problem, jointly learning a diffusion-based visuomotor policy and per-sample source weights that minimize an objective informed by target-domain generalization guarantees. To make best-effort adaptation practical for high-dimensional sequence policies, we develop scalable instance-level discrepancy estimators, stochastic alternating updates for policy and weights, and a multi-source extension that balances heterogeneous source domains. Across sim-to-sim, sim-to-real, and multi-source manipulation settings, BEACON improves robustness and data efficiency over target-only, fixed-ratio co-training, and feature-alignment baselines. Importantly, even without an explicit alignment objective, BEACON achieves feature alignment as an implicit result of discrepancy-aware cross-domain co-training.
tldr: BEACON is a framework for cross-domain co-training of generative robot policies using discrepancy-aware importance weighting, enabling effective sim-to-real and multi-source adaptation.
tldr_zh: BEACON是一个用于跨域协同训练生成式机器人策略的框架，通过差异感知的重要性加权，实现有效的仿真到现实和多源适应。
summary_zh: 本文介绍BEACON框架——一种基于理论驱动的跨域协同训练自适应优化方法，用于在源域演示数据充足而目标域演示数据有限的情况下训练生成式机器人策略。BEACON将跨域协同训练构建为差异感知的重要性重加权问题，通过联合学习基于扩散模型的视觉运动策略与样本级源域权重，最小化基于目标域泛化保证的损失函数。为实现高维序列策略的高效自适应，我们开发了可扩展的实例级差异估计器、策略与权重的随机交替更新机制，以及平衡异构源域的多源扩展方案。在仿真到仿真、仿真到现实及多源操作场景中，BEACON相较于纯目标域训练、固定比例协同训练及特征对齐基线方法，显著提升了策略的鲁棒性与数据效率。值得注意的是，即使没有显式的对齐目标，BEACON通过差异感知的跨域协同训练，隐式地实现了特征对齐效果。

title: SceneFactory: GPU-Accelerated Multi-Agent Driving Simulation with Physics-Based Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Autonomous-driving simulators typically trade physical fidelity for scalable parallelism. Physics-based platforms such as CARLA and MetaDrive provide articulated vehicle dynamics and contact, but their non-vectorized interfaces make batched training difficult. GPU-batched systems such as Waymax and GPUDrive scale to hundreds of scenarios by replacing rigid-body physics with simplified kinematic models, omitting tire--road interaction, suspension, contact dynamics, and road-condition-dependent friction. We introduce SceneFactory, a GPU-vectorized platform for procedural scene construction, physics-based multi-agent simulation, and RL in autonomous-driving environments. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim + Isaac Lab, SceneFactory represents worlds and agents as batched tensors: control, observations, rewards, resets, and policy inference run as GPU tensor operations over the Isaac Lab tensor API. SceneFactory converts Waymo Open Motion Dataset road topologies into simulation-ready USD worlds, runs many worlds concurrently on one GPU, populates each with multiple articulated PhysX vehicles, and maps precipitation and road-surface type to PhysX material friction coefficients. With GPU vectorization, SceneFactory achieves up to 127$\times$ higher throughput than a non-vectorized PhysX baseline on the same GPU and physics solver, reaching 19,250 controlled-agent simulation steps per second at 256 worlds $\times$ 16 agents. Cross-simulator transfer reveals an asymmetric dynamics gap: physics-grounded RL policies transfer to a simplified kinematic bicycle model with 99.5% success, whereas reverse transfer drops to 47.3%. Under wet-road friction, friction-aware policies reduce mean peak DRAC from 58.7 to 27.8,m/s$^2$ without sacrificing goal reach. SceneFactory shows that scalable autonomous-driving training need not discard articulated rigid-body dynamics or physically grounded road-condition variation.
tldr: SceneFactory introduces a GPU-vectorized, physics-based multi-agent driving simulator for scalable RL training, achieving high throughput while retaining articulated vehicle dynamics and road-condition variation, and demonstrates improved policy transfer and safety under wet conditions.
tldr_zh: SceneFactory提出了一个GPU向量化、基于物理的多智能体驾驶模拟器，用于可扩展的强化学习训练，在保留车辆动力学和路面条件变化的同时实现高吞吐量，并展示了在湿滑路况下改善的策略迁移和安全性。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶仿真器通常以牺牲物理保真度为代价换取可扩展的并行化。基于物理的平台（如CARLA和MetaDrive）提供精细的车辆动力学与接触模拟，但其非向量化接口难以实现批量训练。Waymax和GPUDrive等GPU批处理系统通过用简化运动学模型替代刚体物理，实现了数百个场景的并行仿真，但忽略了轮胎-路面交互、悬架系统、接触动力学以及随路况变化的摩擦效应。本文提出SceneFactory——一个基于GPU向量化的平台，支持自动驾驶环境中的程序化场景构建、基于物理的多智能体仿真与强化学习。该平台基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim与Isaac Lab构建，将场景与智能体表示为批量张量：控制、观测、奖励、重置和策略推理均通过Isaac Lab张量API以GPU张量运算执行。SceneFactory将Waymo开放运动数据集的道路拓扑转化为可直接仿真的USD场景，在单GPU上并行运行多个世界，每个场景部署多个采用PhysX铰接式车辆模型，并根据降水与路面类型将物理摩擦系数映射至PhysX材质。通过GPU向量化技术，在相同GPU与物理求解器条件下，SceneFactory相比非向量化PhysX基准实现了最高127倍的吞吐量提升，在256个场景×16个智能体的配置下达到每秒19,250次受控智能体仿真步长。跨仿真器迁移实验揭示了动力学表征的不对称性：基于物理训练的强化学习策略向简化运动学自行车模型迁移成功率高达99.5%，而反向迁移成功率骤降至47.3%。在湿滑路面摩擦条件下，具备摩擦感知能力的策略在保持目标到达率的同时，将平均峰值DRAC从58.7 m/s²降至27.8 m/s²。SceneFactory证明：可扩展的自动驾驶训练无需舍弃铰接式刚体动力学或基于物理真实性的路况变化模拟。

title: Trajectory-Consistent Flow Matching for Robust Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: Flow matching policies learn continuous velocity fields that transport noise to actions, enabling fast deterministic inference for robot manipulation. However, standard training optimizes a pointwise velocity objective while inference requires numerical integration of that field -- a mismatch that causes compounding trajectory errors. We propose four complementary remedies: (1) auxiliary rectified flow velocity regression that provides uniform temporal supervision across the full time interval; (2) multi-step trajectory consistency training that supervises the integrated displacement of the velocity field over trajectory segments, directly closing the train-inference gap; (3) velocity field regularization that enforces temporal smoothness, preventing oscillations that destabilize integration; and (4) fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) inference that reduces global discretization error by orders of magnitude over Euler methods. Critically, these components are not independently sufficient -- RK4 without a smooth velocity field fails, and smoothness without trajectory-level supervision still drifts, as our ablation study confirms. We further pair these with a dual-view 3D point cloud encoder using two independent PointNet encoders for complementary spatial perception. On four real-robot tasks across a Franka arm and a Boston Dynamics Spot, our method achieves 70% and 60% overall success on two long-horizon multi-phase tasks where both baselines score 0%, and reaches 100% on precision tool placement. Three MetaWorld simulation tasks confirm consistent improvements, validating that trajectory-level supervision is essential for reliable policy execution.
tldr: The paper proposes Trajectory-Consistent Flow Matching, a method combining auxiliary rectified flow regression, multi-step trajectory consistency training, velocity regularization, and RK4 inference to improve visuomotor policy learning for robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出轨迹一致流匹配方法，结合辅助整流流回归、多步轨迹一致性训练、速度正则化和RK4推理，以改进机器人操纵的视觉运动策略学习。
summary_zh: 流匹配策略学习将噪声传输至动作的连续速度场，从而为机器人操作实现快速确定性推理。然而，标准训练优化的是逐点速度目标，而推理过程需要对该速度场进行数值积分——这种不匹配会导致轨迹误差不断累积。我们提出四种互补的改进方案：（1）辅助修正流速度回归方法，为整个时间区间提供均匀的时间监督；（2）多步轨迹一致性训练，通过监督速度场在轨迹段上的积分位移，直接弥合训练与推理的差距；（3）速度场正则化，强制时间平滑性以防止积分过程中的振荡失稳；（4）四阶龙格-库塔（RK4）推理方法，相比欧拉法可将全局离散化误差降低数个数量级。关键的是，这些组件单独使用时均无法取得理想效果——我们的消融实验证实，缺乏平滑速度场的RK4会失效，而缺乏轨迹级监督的平滑性仍会导致漂移。我们进一步将其与双视角三维点云编码器相结合，该编码器使用两个独立的PointNet编码器以实现互补的空间感知。在Franka机械臂和波士顿动力Spot机器人上进行的四项真实机器人任务中，我们的方法在两个长时程多阶段任务中实现了70%和60%的整体成功率（基线方法均为0%），并在精密工具放置任务中达到100%成功率。三个MetaWorld仿真任务验证了该方法具有一致的性能提升，证明轨迹级监督对于策略执行的可靠性至关重要。

title: Failing Forward: Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.
tldr: Proposes Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), a framework that uses online-generated failure trajectories to adaptively guide diffusion-/flow-based VLA policies, improving robustness in robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了自适应失败信息学习（AFIL），一个利用在线生成的失败轨迹自适应引导基于扩散/流的VLA策略的框架，以提高机器人操作任务中的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为可扩展的机器人操作提供了一种有前景的范式，然而其仅依赖成功行为克隆的方式使其性能较为脆弱；由于缺乏修正性训练信号，微小的执行误差会迅速累积为难以恢复的、超出分布范围的失败。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了自适应失败感知学习（AFIL），这是一种端到端框架，利用失败轨迹作为基于扩散和流模型的VLA策略的自适应负向指导。AFIL使用预训练的VLA模型在线生成失败轨迹，无需人工设计故障模式或依赖人工介入的恢复过程。该框架通过共享一个通用的视觉-语言主干网络，联合训练针对成功行为和失败行为的双动作生成器（DAGs），从而以有限的参数量开销实现高效且具备失败感知的策略学习。在采样过程中，失败生成器能够自适应地引导动作生成远离易失败区域，转向更可靠的成功模式，其指导强度由扩散过程中每一步的成功与失败分布之间的距离决定。在领域内及领域外的机器人操作任务实验（涵盖短期与长期任务设置）中，AFIL相比现有VLA基线方法持续提升了任务成功率和鲁棒性，验证了其有效性、效率与通用性。

title: Octopus Protocol: One-Shot Hardware Discovery and Control for AI Agents via Infrastructure-as-Prompts
summary: Recent agentic-robotics systems, from Code-asPolicies to modern vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models, presuppose that drivers, SDKs, or ROS-style primitives for the target hardware already exist. Writing those primitives is the dominant engineering cost of bringing up new hardware for agent control. We present Octopus Protocol, a system that collapses that cost to a single shell command. Given only raw OS access and a language-model API key, a coding agent executes a five-stage pipeline--PROBE, IDENTIFY, INTERFACE, SERVE, DEPLOY--to discover connected devices, infer their capabilities, generate a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with typed tools, and deploy it as a live HTTP endpoint. A persistent daemon then monitors the system, heals broken code, and perceives physical state through the camera tools it generated for itself. Two architectural principles make this work: protocols are prompts, not code, and the coding agent is the runtime. We validate the system on three heterogeneous platforms (PC/WSL, Apple Silicon macOS, Raspberry Pi 4) and on a commercial 6-DOF robotic arm with USB camera feedback. One command onboards the hardware in ~10-15 minutes and exposes up to 30 MCP tools; an MCP-compliant client then performs closed-loop visual-motor control through tools no human wrote.
tldr: A system called Octopus Protocol automates hardware discovery, interface generation, and deployment for AI agents via a coding agent pipeline, enabling one-shot onboarding of heterogeneous hardware, including robotic arms, for closed-loop control without human-written drivers.
tldr_zh: Octopus Protocol 系统通过编码代理流水线，实现硬件发现、接口生成和部署自动化，支持一键接入异构硬件（包括机械臂）进行闭环控制，无需人工编写驱动。
summary_zh: 摘要：近来的智能机器人系统，从代码即策略到现代视觉-语言-动作基础模型，均预设目标硬件已具备驱动程序、软件开发工具包或ROS式原语。而编写这些原语，是部署新硬件以实现智能体控制的主要工程成本。我们提出了Octopus协议，该系统将此项成本缩减为一条简单的Shell命令。仅需原始操作系统访问权限和语言模型API密钥，编码代理即执行五阶段流程——探测、识别、接口构建、服务部署——以发现连接设备、推断其功能、生成带有类型化工具的模型上下文协议服务器，并将其部署为实时HTTP端点。随后，一个持续运行的后台守护进程监控系统、修复故障代码，并通过其自主生成的摄像头工具感知物理状态。两项架构原则支撑了该系统：协议即提示，而非代码；编码代理即运行时环境。我们在三个异构平台（PC/WSL、Apple Silicon macOS、Raspberry Pi 4）以及配备USB摄像头反馈的商用六自由度机械臂上验证了该系统。单条命令即可在约10至15分钟内完成硬件接入，并暴露多达30个MCP工具；随后，符合MCP标准的客户端通过无人编写的工具，实现了闭环视觉-运动控制。

title: VECTOR-Drive: Tightly Coupled Vision-Language and Trajectory Expert Routing for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving requires models to understand traffic scenes, infer driving intent, and generate executable motion plans. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit semantic priors from large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet still face a coupling trade-off: fully shared backbones preserve multimodal interaction but may entangle language reasoning and trajectory prediction, whereas decou pled reasoning-action pipelines reduce task conflict but weaken semantic-motion coupling. We propose VECTOR-DRIVE, a tightly coupled VLA framework built on Qwen2.5-VL-3B. VECTOR-DRIVE keeps all tokens coupled through shared self attention and routes feed-forward computation according to token semantics. Vision and language tokens are processed by a Vision-Language Expert to preserve semantic priors, while target-point, ego-state, and noisy action tokens are routed to a Trajectory Expert for motion-specific computation. On the action-token pathway, a flow-matching planner refines noisy action tokens into future waypoints and speed profiles. This design couples semantic reasoning and motion planning within a single multimodal Transformer while separating task-specific FFN computation. On Bench2Drive, VECTOR-DRIVE achieves 88.91 Driving Score and outperforms representative end-to end and VLA-based baselines. Qualitative results and ablations further validate the benefits of shared attention, semantic-aware expert routing, progressive training, and flow-based action de coding.
tldr: VECTOR-DRIVE is a tightly coupled vision-language-action (VLA) model for autonomous driving that uses semantic-aware expert routing within a single multimodal Transformer to jointly reason about scene semantics and generate motion plans, achieving state-of-the-art performance on an end-to-end driving benchmark.
tldr_zh: VECTOR-DRIVE是一个用于端到端自动驾驶的紧密耦合视觉-语言-动作模型，它在单一多模态Transformer内通过语义感知专家路由，联合进行场景语义推理和运动规划生成，在驾驶基准测试中取得领先性能。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶要求模型理解交通场景、推断驾驶意图并生成可执行的运动规划。近期出现的视觉-语言-动作模型继承了大规模视觉-语言预训练中的语义先验，但仍面临耦合权衡问题：完全共享的骨干网络虽能保持多模态交互，却可能混淆语言推理与轨迹预测；而解耦的推理-行动流水线虽能减少任务冲突，却削弱了语义与运动的耦合。我们提出VECTOR-DRIVE——基于Qwen2.5-VL-3B构建的紧密耦合VLA框架。该框架通过共享自注意力机制保持所有标记的耦合状态，并根据标记语义路由前馈计算：视觉与语言标记由视觉-语言专家处理以保留语义先验，而目标点、自车状态及含噪动作标记则路由至轨迹专家进行运动专项计算。在动作标记通路上，流匹配规划器将含噪动作标记逐步优化为未来路径点与速度剖面。该设计在单一多模态Transformer中实现语义推理与运动规划的耦合，同时分离任务专用的前馈网络计算。在Bench2Drive测试中，VECTOR-DRIVE获得88.91驾驶分数，超越代表性端到端及基于VLA的基线模型。定性结果与消融实验进一步验证了共享注意力、语义感知专家路由、渐进式训练及基于流的动作解码机制的有效性。

title: ElasticFlow: One-Step Physics-Consistent Policy with Elastic Time Horizons for Language-Guided Manipulation
summary: Diffusion policies have demonstrated exceptional performance in embodied AI. However, their iterative denoising process results in high latency, and existing acceleration methods often sacrifice physical consistency. To address this, we propose ElasticFlow, a distillation-free, physics-consistent one-step policy framework. We reconstruct the Mean Field Theory by directly modeling the average velocity field, enabling a direct single-step mapping from noise to action. Addressing the Temporal Heterogeneity of robotic tasks, we introduce the Elastic Time Horizons mechanism. This mechanism effectively overcomes Spectral Bias by explicitly encoding control granularity, achieving efficient alignment between semantic instructions and physical execution horizons. Experiments on benchmarks such as LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboTwin demonstrate that ElasticFlow achieves efficient 1-NFE inference (approximately 71Hz). Furthermore, it outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including OpenVLA and $π_0$, on long-horizon tasks, highlighting its potential for efficient, robust, and semantically aligned control.
tldr: ElasticFlow is a distillation-free, physics-consistent one-step policy that directly maps noise to action, overcoming spectral bias via Elastic Time Horizons for efficient language-guided manipulation.
tldr_zh: ElasticFlow是一种免蒸馏、物理一致的单步策略框架，通过弹性时间视界机制直接建模平均速度场，实现高效的语言引导操作。
summary_zh: 扩散策略在具身智能领域已展现出卓越性能。然而，其迭代去噪过程导致较高的延迟，而现有的加速方法往往以牺牲物理一致性为代价。为解决这一问题，我们提出ElasticFlow——一个无需蒸馏、保持物理一致性的单步策略框架。我们通过直接建模平均速度场重构了平均场理论，实现了从噪声到动作的直接单步映射。针对机器人任务中的时间异质性问题，我们引入了弹性时间跨度机制。该机制通过显式编码控制粒度有效克服了谱偏差，实现了语义指令与物理执行跨度的精准高效对齐。在LIBERO、CALVIN和RoboTwin等基准测试上的实验表明，ElasticFlow实现了高效的单步推理（约71Hz），并在长跨度任务中超越了包括OpenVLA和$π_0$在内的最先进方法，凸显了其在高效、鲁棒且语义对齐的控制任务中的巨大潜力。

title: Latent Geometry Beyond Search: Amortizing Planning in World Models
summary: Modern vision-based world models can represent observations as compact yet expressive latent manifolds, but fast goal-oriented planning in these spaces remains challenging. This raises a central question: when does a learned representation simplify control, rather than merely enabling prediction? We study this question in a pretrained LeWorldModel, whose latent geometry is regularized for smoothness and uniformity. Our key insight is that, under such geometry, planning can be amortized into a latent inverse-dynamics mapping instead of requiring online search. We therefore replace iterative planning with a lightweight Goal-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics Model (GC-IDM) that maps the current latent state, goal latent state, and remaining horizon directly to the next action. Empirically, across four benchmark environments spanning navigation, contact-rich manipulation, and continuous control, our controller matches or exceeds CEM in seven of eight environment-protocol settings while reducing per-decision cost by 100-130x. A broader sweep over test-time planners (CEM, MPPI, iCEM, and gradient-based methods) shows that this result is not specific to a particular optimizer. These findings suggest that much of the structure recovered by test-time planning is already locally encoded in the latent representation. More broadly, our results indicate that sufficiently structured latent spaces can shift part of the planning burden from online optimization to learned inference.
tldr: The paper proposes amortizing planning in vision-based world models by using a Goal-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics Model in the latent space, eliminating the need for online search and achieving substantial speedups while matching or exceeding the performance of iterative planners.
tldr_zh: 本文提出在视觉世界模型的隐空间中，通过目标条件逆动力学模型来分摊规划，消除了在线搜索的需求，在实现显著加速的同时，达到或超过了迭代规划器的性能。
summary_zh: 现代基于视觉的世界模型能够将观测表示为紧凑且富有表现力的潜在流形，但在这些空间中进行快速目标导向规划仍然具有挑战性。这引出了一个核心问题：学习到的表示何时能简化控制，而不仅仅是实现预测？我们在预训练的LeWorldModel中研究了这个问题，该模型的潜在几何结构经过平滑性和均匀性正则化。我们的关键洞察是，在这种几何结构下，规划可以被分摊为一种潜在逆动力学映射，而无需进行在线搜索。因此，我们用轻量级目标条件逆动力学模型取代迭代规划，该模型直接将当前潜在状态、目标潜在状态和剩余时间跨度映射到下一个动作。实验表明，在涵盖导航、丰富接触操作和连续控制的四个基准环境中，我们的控制器在八种环境-协议设置中的七种中达到或超过了CEM的性能，同时将每个决策的成本降低了100至130倍。对测试时规划器（CEM、MPPI、iCEM和基于梯度的方法）的广泛测试表明，这一结果并非特定于某个优化器。这些发现表明，测试时规划所恢复的大部分结构已在潜在表示中局部编码。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，足够结构化的潜在空间可以将部分规划负担从在线优化转移到学习推理上。

title: ATAAT: Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning Framework against Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Addressing the escalating security vulnerabilities in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, this study investigates backdoor attacks targeting the visual pathway. We identify a core obstacle causing the failure of traditional attack paradigms: "Gradient Interference." This phenomenon represents an optimization failure triggered by conflicting strategies during end-to-end training. To resolve this, we propose an Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning (ATAAT) framework. Through its core "Threat-Method Adaptive Mapping" mechanism, ATAAT intelligently selects the optimal gradient decoupling strategy based on the adversary's capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ATAAT exhibits significant advantages, achieving a highly robust Targeted Attack Success Rate (TASR > 80%) while maintaining extreme stealthiness with merely a 5% poisoning rate. It efficiently handles complex semantic-level triggers and achieves implicit decoupled attacks in data poisoning scenarios for the first time. This work reveals a critical security vulnerability in VLAs and provides theoretical and methodological support for future defense architectures.
tldr: This paper proposes an adversarial tuning framework for defending against backdoor attacks on Vision-Language-Action models by overcoming gradient interference during training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种自适应威胁感知对抗调优框架，用于防御针对视觉-语言-动作模型的后门攻击，通过解决训练中的梯度干扰问题。
summary_zh: 针对视觉-语言-动作模型日益严峻的安全漏洞问题，本研究聚焦于针对视觉通路的后门攻击。我们发现导致传统攻击范式失效的核心障碍是“梯度干扰”，这种现象源于端到端训练过程中策略冲突引发的优化失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出了自适应威胁感知对抗调优框架。该框架通过核心的“威胁-方法自适应映射”机制，基于攻击者能力智能选择最优梯度解耦策略。大量实验表明，ATAAT框架展现出显著优势：在仅需5%投毒率的极致隐蔽性条件下，实现了超过80%的强鲁棒性定向攻击成功率；不仅能高效处理复杂语义级触发器，更首次在数据投毒场景中实现了隐式解耦攻击。本工作揭示了视觉-语言-动作模型的关键安全缺陷，为未来防御架构的构建提供了理论与方法论支持。

title: LE-PAVD: Learning-Enhanced Physics-Aware Vehicle Dynamics for High-Speed Autonomous Navigation
summary: Accurate modeling of nonlinear vehicle dynamics is essential for high-speed autonomous racing, where controllers operate at the handling limits. Model-based methods are interpretable but rely on simplifying assumptions, while purely learned models capture nonlinearities yet often lack physical consistency and generalization. We propose LE-PAVD (Learning-Enhanced Physics-Aware Vehicle Dynamics), a hybrid model that integrates physics priors with learned components. Our architecture adds four components: load-sensitive Pacejka tire forces, longitudinal load transfer, lateral tire-force effects, and rate-limited actuator inputs. Trained end-to-end on simulation and real-world telemetry, LE-PAVD enforces physical consistency while improving state prediction accuracy. On an unseen track, LE-PAVD reduces average displacement error (ADE) by 16.1$\%$, final displacement error (FDE) by 20.6$\%$, and lowers yaw-rate root mean squared error (RMSE) by 91.3$\%$ versus a deep dynamics baseline, while using 21.6$\%$ fewer FLOPs and achieving approximately 1.50$\times$ faster inference. In closed-loop simulations, LE-PAVD consistently outperforms the baseline by achieving faster lap times by 17.4$\%$ on a training track and 9.5$\%$ on a test track, without any track boundary violations. Overall, LE-PAVD offers a compact, physics-grounded dynamics backbone that improves predictive fidelity and closed-loop performance while reducing inference cost.
tldr: Proposes a hybrid physics-aware vehicle dynamics model for high-speed autonomous racing, integrating physics priors with learned components to improve prediction accuracy and closed-loop performance while reducing inference cost.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于高速自主赛车的高中混合物理感知车辆动力学模型，将物理先验与学习组件结合，以提高预测精度和闭环性能，同时降低推理成本。
summary_zh: 精确建模非线性车辆动力学对于高速自动驾驶赛车至关重要，因为控制器需在操控极限下运行。基于模型的方法具有可解释性，但依赖于简化假设；而纯学习模型虽能捕捉非线性特征，却往往缺乏物理一致性与泛化能力。本文提出LE-PAVD（学习增强的物理感知车辆动力学）——一种融合物理先验与学习组件的混合模型。该架构新增四个核心组件：载荷敏感的Pacejka轮胎力模型、纵向载荷转移效应、横向轮胎力影响以及速率受限的执行器输入。通过在仿真与真实遥测数据上进行端到端训练，LE-PAVD在提升状态预测精度的同时严格保证物理一致性。在未见过的新赛道上，相比深度动力学基线模型，LE-PAVD将平均位移误差（ADE）降低16.1%，最终位移误差（FDE）减少20.6%，横摆角速度均方根误差（RMSE）下降91.3%，同时计算量减少21.6%（以FLOPs计），推理速度提升约1.50倍。在闭环仿真中，LE-PAVD持续优于基线模型：在训练赛道上圈速提升17.4%，在测试赛道上提升9.5%，且全程未发生赛道边界违规。总体而言，LE-PAVD提供了一个紧凑的、基于物理的动力学框架，在降低推理成本的同时，显著提升了预测保真度与闭环控制性能。

title: Latency Analysis and Optimization of Alpamayo 1 via Efficient Trajectory Generation
summary: Reasoning-based end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has recently emerged as a promising approach to improving the interpretability of driving decisions as it can generate human-readable reasoning together with predicted trajectories. Such approaches commonly generate multiple trajectories to capture diverse future behaviors, and they fall into two categories: (1) multi-reasoning, where one reasoning sequence is generated per trajectory, and (2) single-reasoning, where a single reasoning is shared across all trajectories. The former offers richer diversity at the cost of redundant computation, while the latter is more efficient but is often assumed to sacrifice diversity. Alpamayo 1, a representative system, adopts the multi-reasoning approach and achieves competitive trajectory prediction performance. However, the efficiency of this design remains largely unexplored, making it a well-motivated subject for investigation. In this paper, we systematically analyze and improve Alpamayo 1 in two ways. First, we reduce inference latency while preserving trajectory diversity by redesigning Alpamayo 1 into a single-reasoning system. Through extensive experiments, we find that replacing multi-reasoning with single-reasoning does not meaningfully degrade trajectory diversity. Second, we accelerate diffusion-based action generation by eliminating inter-block overhead arising from unnecessary copy operations and inefficient kernel execution. Through closed-loop and open-loop experiments, we validate both optimizations, demonstrating a 69.23% reduction in inference latency while maintaining trajectory diversity and prediction quality. These results highlight the importance of jointly analyzing system architecture and runtime execution to improve the efficiency of reasoning-based E2E AD systems.
tldr: This paper analyzes and optimizes the latency of the Alpamayo 1 reasoning-based end-to-end autonomous driving system by redesigning it into a single-reasoning system and improving the efficiency of its diffusion-based action generation.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将Alpamayo 1重新设计为单推理系统并改进其基于扩散的动作生成效率，系统分析和优化了该推理式端到端自动驾驶系统的推理延迟。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于推理的端到端自动驾驶技术近期展现出提升驾驶决策可解释性的潜力，因其能够生成人类可读的推理过程与预测轨迹。此类方法通常通过生成多条轨迹来捕捉多样化的未来行为，主要分为两类：（1）多推理模式，即每条轨迹对应独立的推理序列；（2）单推理模式，即所有轨迹共享同一推理过程。前者虽能提供更丰富的多样性，却以冗余计算为代价；后者效率更高，但常被认为会牺牲多样性。代表性系统Alpamayo 1采用多推理方法，取得了具有竞争力的轨迹预测性能。然而，该设计在效率方面的表现尚未得到充分探索，这使其成为值得深入研究的课题。本文通过两种方式系统性地分析与改进Alpamayo 1系统。首先，我们将Alpamayo 1重构为单推理系统，在保持轨迹多样性的同时降低推理延迟。大量实验表明，用单推理替代多推理不会显著削弱轨迹多样性。其次，我们通过消除因不必要的复制操作和低效内核执行产生的块间开销，加速了基于扩散模型的动作生成。通过闭环与开环实验验证，两项优化在维持轨迹多样性与预测质量的同时，实现了69.23%的推理延迟降低。这些结果突显了联合分析系统架构与运行时执行对提升基于推理的端到端自动驾驶系统效率的重要性。

title: LCGNav: Local Candidate-Aware Geometric Enhancement for General Topological Planning in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Online topological planning has become an effective paradigm for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE), but existing methods still suffer from two limitations: redundant local depth information and weakened focus on current frontier candidates as the topological graph grows. To address this, we propose LCGNav, a modular local geometric enhancement framework for topological VLN. LCGNav explicitly converts candidate depth views into 3D point clouds and applies physical truncation based on the agent's reachable range, enabling more compact local geometric modeling. It further introduces a dimension-preserving local fusion strategy with transient state degradation, so that geometric enhancement is applied only to the currently relevant ghost nodes without changing the original planner interface. Experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE show that LCGNav serves as an effective cross-architecture enhancement module, consistently improving multiple key metrics of representative online topological baselines with low additional training cost. When integrated with ETP-R1, LCGNav achieves the best performance among the compared online topological methods on the val-unseen splits of the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/shannanshouyin/LCGNav.
tldr: Proposes LCGNav, a modular local geometric enhancement framework for online topological Vision-Language Navigation, improving performance by converting depth views to 3D point clouds and focusing geometric fusion on relevant frontier candidates.
tldr_zh: 提出LCGNav，一个用于在线拓扑视觉语言导航的模块化局部几何增强框架，通过将深度视图转换为3D点云并聚焦于相关前沿候选的几何融合来提升性能。
summary_zh: 在线拓扑规划已成为连续环境视觉语言导航的有效范式，但现有方法仍存在两个局限：冗余的局部深度信息以及随拓扑图增长而对当前前沿候选位置关注度减弱的问题。为此，我们提出LCGNav——一种面向拓扑视觉语言导航的模块化局部几何增强框架。LCGNav显式地将候选深度视图转换为三维点云，并根据智能体可达范围进行物理截断，从而实现更紧凑的局部几何建模。该框架进一步引入具有瞬态退化特性的维度保持局部融合策略，使得几何增强仅作用于当前相关的虚拟节点，而无需改变原有规划器接口。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上的实验表明，LCGNav作为跨架构增强模块，能够以较低的训练成本持续提升代表性在线拓扑基线的多项关键指标。与ETP-R1结合后，LCGNav在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准测试的val-unseen划分上取得了对比在线拓扑方法中的最佳性能。代码开源地址：https://github.com/shannanshouyin/LCGNav。

title: Towards Backdoor-Based Ownership Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) support generalist robotic control by enabling end-to-end decision policies directly from multi-modal inputs. As trained VLAs are increasingly shared and adapted, protecting model ownership becomes essential for secure deployment and responsible open-source usage. In this paper, we present GuardVLA, the first backdoor-based ownership verification framework specifically designed for VLAs. GuardVLA embeds a stealthy and harmless backdoor watermark into the protected model during training by injecting secret messages into embodied visual data. For post-release verification, we propose a swap-and-detect mechanism, in which the trigger projector and an external classifier head are used to activate and detect the embedded backdoor based on prediction probabilities. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets, model architectures, and adaptation settings demonstrate that GuardVLA enables reliable ownership verification while preserving benign task performance. Further results show that the embedded watermark remains detectable under post-release model adaptation.
tldr: Proposes GuardVLA, a backdoor-based ownership verification framework for Vision-Language-Action models, embedding a stealthy watermark during training for reliable verification post-release.
tldr_zh: 提出GuardVLA，一个基于后门的视觉-语言-动作模型所有权验证框架，在训练中嵌入隐蔽水印，用于模型发布后的可靠验证。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）通过多模态输入直接生成端到端决策策略，支持通用机器人控制。随着已训练的VLAs日益广泛地被共享与适配，保护模型所有权成为保障安全部署与负责任开源使用的关键。本文提出GuardVLA——首个专门为VLAs设计的基于后门的所有权验证框架。该框架通过在训练阶段向具身视觉数据中注入秘密信息，将隐蔽且无害的后门水印嵌入受保护模型。针对发布后验证，我们提出一种交换-检测机制，利用触发投影器与外部分类器头基于预测概率激活并检测嵌入的后门。通过在多个数据集、模型架构及适配设置中的大量实验证明，GuardVLA在保持良性任务性能的同时，能够实现可靠的所有权验证。进一步研究结果显示，嵌入的水印在模型发布后的适配过程中仍保持可检测性。

title: A low-cost mockup to simulate robotic laser cutting in nuclear decommissioning
summary: This paper introduces a low-cost experimental mockup to simulate the laser cutting process of containers in nuclear decommissioning. It is composed of a three-axis table supporting a cuboid container with ultraviolet-sensitive faces, a six-degree-of-freedom serial manipulator holding an ultraviolet torch that simulates the laser, and a visual system based on cameras and fiducial markers. The system employs a constrained task-space adaptive motion controller that compensates for inaccurate parameters and eliminates the need to calibrate the system. Furthermore, as the motion controller explicitly accounts for geometric constraints, the robot reactively avoids collisions with obstacles while handling the ultraviolet torch. To enhance tracking of the laser-cutting path, we control the ultraviolet beam, which requires only four degrees of freedom, instead of the full end-effector pose. Experiments show that, despite an initially uncalibrated system, the overall system is capable of tracking different trajectories with an overall mean accuracy of 3.9 (sd 2.5) mm when the end-effector pose is controlled and 2.4 (sd 1.3) mm when the ultraviolet beam is controlled.
tldr: The paper presents a low-cost mockup system with an uncalibrated constrained adaptive motion controller for simulating robotic laser cutting in nuclear decommissioning, achieving improved tracking accuracy by controlling a UV beam instead of the full end-effector pose.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模拟核退役中机器人激光切割的低成本模拟系统，采用未校准的约束自适应运动控制器，并通过控制UV光束而非完整末端执行器位姿来提高轨迹跟踪精度。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于模拟核设施退役中容器激光切割过程的低成本实验模型。该模型由三轴工作台、六自由度串联机械臂及基于摄像头与基准标记的视觉系统组成。三轴台支撑着具有紫外线敏感表面的长方体容器，机械臂末端装有模拟激光的紫外线发射装置。系统采用具有约束条件的任务空间自适应运动控制器，能够补偿参数误差，无需进行系统标定。此外，由于该运动控制器显式考虑了几何约束，机械臂在操作紫外线发射装置时能实时规避障碍物碰撞。为提升激光切割路径的跟踪精度，我们采用仅需四个自由度的紫外线光束控制方案，而非控制完整的末端执行器位姿。实验表明：在系统未经初始标定的情况下，当控制末端执行器位姿时，系统整体跟踪不同轨迹的平均精度为3.9（标准差2.5）毫米；当控制紫外线光束时，平均精度可达2.4（标准差1.3）毫米。

title: A Visuo-Tactile Data Collection System with Haptic Feedback for Coarse-to-Fine Imitation Learning
summary: We present a visuo-tactile data-collection system that generates temporally structured, contact-rich demonstrations for imitation learning. Conventional systems often decouple the operator from contact forces, which hinders the demonstration of subtle force modulation. Our system introduces a direct-drive gripper that the operator actuates with the fingers, preserving natural haptic feedback. Integrated visual sensors and custom tactile arrays capture image streams and contact geometry. A handle-mounted push button enables the operator to annotate the task's temporal structure in real time by marking task-critical regions. By fusing in-hand force perception with in-situ temporal annotation, the system produces multimodal datasets designed for coarse-to-fine learning algorithms that exploit structural task knowledge, enabling the development of high-quality manipulation policies.
tldr: Presents a visuo-tactile data collection system with direct-drive haptic feedback and real-time temporal annotation for generating contact-rich demonstrations, targeting coarse-to-fine imitation learning for manipulation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种视觉触觉数据收集系统，具有直接驱动触觉反馈和实时时间标注功能，用于生成接触丰富的演示，针对操作的从粗到细模仿学习。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉—触觉数据采集系统，该系统能够为模仿学习生成具有时间结构、接触丰富的演示数据。传统系统往往将操作者与接触力解耦，这阻碍了对细微力调制的演示。我们的系统采用了一种由操作者手指直接驱动的直驱式夹持器，保留了自然的触觉反馈。集成的视觉传感器与定制化触觉阵列可同步采集图像流与接触几何信息。手柄上的按钮使操作者能够通过标记任务关键区域，实时标注任务的时间结构。通过融合手部力感知与现场时间标注，该系统可生成专为利用任务结构知识的从粗到精学习算法而设计的多元模态数据集，从而支持高质量操作策略的研发。

title: Enhancing Consistency Models for Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
summary: Diffusion models for multi-agent trajectory prediction are limited by iterative denoising, which causes inference latency that hinders their use in time-critical settings like autonomous driving. Fast-sampling variants using DDIM and informed initial noise distributions partially alleviate this issue, but they either fail to achieve true single-step generation or are constrained by the chosen noise distribution. Consistency Models (CMs) offer high-quality one-step generation by mapping noise directly to data, but are difficult to train from scratch . We propose ECTraj, an enhanced CM pipeline with improved training and conditional generation for trajectory prediction. Our framework extends the student-teacher consistency training scheme: the student produces standard outputs, while the teacher explicitly fuses its predictions with parts of the ground truth to give stronger supervision. We also exploit CMs' direct denoising for top-K multi-shot generation during training. Combining conditional generation with this enhanced consistency objective yields faster inference and improved prediction accuracy, establishing competitive new benchmarks on the large-scale Argoverse 2 dataset.
tldr: The paper proposes ECTraj, an enhanced consistency model pipeline for multi-agent trajectory prediction, achieving faster single-step inference and improved accuracy by extending a student-teacher training scheme with explicit ground-truth fusion and exploiting direct denoising for top-K multi-shot generation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出ECTraj，一种用于多智能体轨迹预测的增强一致性模型框架，通过扩展师生训练方案、融合地面真值以及利用直接去噪进行top-K多模态生成，实现了更快的单步推理和更高的预测准确性。
summary_zh: 用于多智能体轨迹预测的扩散模型受限于迭代去噪过程，其带来的推理延迟阻碍了其在自动驾驶等时效敏感场景中的应用。采用DDIM和改进初始噪声分布的快速采样变体虽部分缓解了此问题，但无法实现真正单步生成，或受限于预设噪声分布。一致性模型通过直接将噪声映射至数据实现高质量单步生成，但难以从零训练。我们提出ECTraj——一种针对轨迹预测的增强型一致性模型框架，具备改进的训练机制和条件生成能力。该框架扩展了师生一致性训练范式：学生模型生成标准输出，教师模型则将其预测与部分真实轨迹显式融合以提供更强监督信号。训练过程中，我们利用一致性模型的直接去噪特性实现Top-K多轨迹生成。结合条件生成与增强的一致性目标，本方法在提升推理速度的同时改善了预测精度，于大规模Argoverse 2数据集上建立了具有竞争力的新基准。

title: ACWM-Phys: Investigating Generalized Physical Interaction in Action-Conditioned Video World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) have shown strong promise for video prediction and decision-making. However, existing benchmarks are largely restricted to egocentric navigation or narrow, task-specific robotics datasets, offering only limited coverage of the rich physical interactions required for generalized world understanding. We introduce ACWM-Phys, a new benchmark for evaluating action-conditioned prediction under diverse physical dynamics in a clean, controllable simulation environment with a carefully designed action space. ACWM-Phys contains training and evaluation data spanning rigid-body dynamics, kinematics, deformable-object interactions, and particle dynamics. To evaluate both interpolation and generalization, we design in-distribution and out-of-distribution protocols with controlled shifts in interaction patterns or scene configurations. By building the benchmark in a fully controllable simulator, ACWM-Phys enables precise data collection, reproducible evaluation, and systematic analysis of model capabilities for physically grounded world modeling. Through systematic experiments on ACWM-DiT, we find that OoD generalization depends not only on the physical regime but also on effective task complexity: models generalize well on visually simple, low-dimensional interactions with clear geometric structure, but suffer larger drops on deformable contacts, high-dimensional control, and complex articulated motion. This suggests that the model still relies heavily on visual appearance patterns instead of fully learning the underlying physics. Ablations show that cross-attention improves high-dimensional action conditioning, causal VAEs outperform frame-wise encoders, and larger action spaces are harder to model but can improve generalization by providing richer control signals. These findings guide the design of physically grounded world models.
tldr: Introduces ACWM-Phys, a benchmark for evaluating action-conditioned world models on diverse physical interactions, revealing insights on generalization and model design.
tldr_zh: 提出ACWM-Phys，一个用于评估动作条件世界模型在多样化物理交互中性能的基准，揭示了模型泛化能力和设计见解。
summary_zh: 动作条件世界模型在视频预测与决策领域展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有基准测试主要局限于第一人称导航或特定任务的机器人数据集，对广义世界理解所需的丰富物理交互覆盖有限。本文提出ACWM-Phys——一个在洁净可控的仿真环境中构建的新型基准测试，通过精心设计的动作空间评估多样化物理动力学下的动作条件预测能力。该基准涵盖刚体动力学、运动学、可变形物体交互与粒子动力学的训练和评估数据。为同时评估内插与泛化性能，我们设计了包含交互模式或场景配置受控变化的分布内与分布外测试协议。通过在完全可控的仿真器中构建基准，ACWM-Phys能够实现精确数据收集、可复现的评估，以及对物理基础世界模型能力的系统分析。通过对ACWM-DiT的系统实验，我们发现分布外泛化能力不仅取决于物理机制，更受有效任务复杂度影响：模型在视觉简单、低维度且具有清晰几何结构的交互中表现良好，但在可变形接触、高维控制和复杂铰接运动场景中性能显著下降。这表明模型仍严重依赖视觉表观模式，未能完全学习底层物理规律。消融实验显示：交叉注意力机制可改善高维动作条件处理，因果VAE优于逐帧编码器，扩大动作空间虽增加建模难度，但可通过提供更丰富的控制信号提升泛化能力。这些发现为物理基础世界模型的设计提供了指导。

title: HyDRA Scorpion: A Cost-effective and Modular ROV for Real-Time Underwater Inspection, Intervention, and Object Detection
summary: A Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) is a tethered underwater robot used for tasks like inspection and intervention. While essential tools for underwater science, the high cost of commercial ROVs and a persistent gap between mechanically capable platforms and those with integrated intelligence create a significant barrier to access. HyDRA Scorpion differs from conventional systems by addressing these challenges, integrating an advanced, AI-driven perception stack with in-situ measurement capabilities onto a low-cost, locally manufacturable platform. The system combines 4-DoF maneuverability, dual manipulators, and a custom pressure-tested housing. Experimental results validate the system's robustness and performance. Leak-free operation was confirmed through prolonged pressure testing of the electronics housing to 4 bar, equivalent to the pressure of a 304.8-meter water depth approximately in a simulated environment, with no moisture ingress detected. The vehicle also demonstrated stable station-keeping, maintaining its position within a tight tolerance of $\(\pm\)0.15$ meters under external disturbances. The onboard AI module achieved underwater object detection mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.89 with real-time inference, length and 3D-mapping based distance measurement. Also, 4-DoF manipulator arm can grip and maintain dual-function manipulator feature which support 360 degree tangle-free rotation.
tldr: The paper presents a low-cost, modular ROV with AI-driven perception, real-time object detection, and dual manipulators for underwater inspection and intervention tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种低成本、模块化的ROV，具备AI驱动的感知、实时物体检测和双机械手，用于水下检查和干预任务。
summary_zh: 远程操作潜水器（ROV）是一种用于检查与作业等任务的系缆式水下机器人。尽管作为水下科学的重要工具，商业ROV的高昂成本以及机械性能平台与集成智能平台之间长期存在的差距，极大地限制了其普及应用。HyDRA Scorpion系统通过应对这些挑战，区别于传统方案：它将先进的人工智能感知系统与现场测量能力集成于一个低成本、可本地制造的平台上。该系统融合了四自由度机动性、双机械臂及定制化耐压壳体。实验结果表明该系统具有优异的鲁棒性与性能表现：电子舱在模拟环境中通过了相当于约304.8米水深压力的4巴长期压力测试，未检测到任何湿气侵入，证实了其完全密封性能。该潜器在外部扰动下展现出稳定的定位保持能力，位置偏移控制在±0.15米范围内。搭载的人工智能模块实现了水下物体检测平均精度均值（mAP）0.89的实时推理性能，并可进行基于长度与三维建模的距离测量。同时，四自由度机械臂具备抓取功能，其双功能机械手支持360度无缠绕旋转特性。

title: Raymoval: Raycasting-based Dynamic Object Removal for Static 3D Mapping
summary: Static mapping is fundamental to robot navigation, providing a persistent geometric prior and a consistent reference for long-term autonomy. However, dynamic objects leave residual traces and cause surface loss, which reduces map consistency. We propose a raycasting-based module for dynamic object removal in static 3D mapping. Each scan is projected onto an azimuth-elevation grid, and for every viewing direction we compare the bin-wise minimum range with the map's first-hit distance computed by raycasting. Furthermore, we apply a raycast consistency test that separates dynamic from static points. Finally, a spatial consistency validation step refines labels, producing static maps with lower residual dynamics and reduced over-removal. We evaluate our approach quantitatively and qualitatively on SemanticKITTI and a challenging custom dataset, and show consistent static mapping results.
tldr: The paper proposes a raycasting-based method to remove dynamic objects from 3D scans for static mapping in robot navigation, improving map consistency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于光线投射的方法，用于从机器人导航的3D扫描中移除动态物体以实现静态建图，提高了地图的一致性。
summary_zh: 静态地图是机器人导航的基础，它为长期自主运行提供了持久的几何先验和一致的参考基准。然而，动态物体会在静态地图中留下残存轨迹并导致表面缺失，从而降低地图的一致性。为此，我们提出了一种基于射线投射的静态三维地图构建方法用于移除动态物体。我们将每次扫描数据投影到方位-仰角网格中，针对每个观测方向，将距离分段最小值与通过射线投射计算的地图首次命中距离进行对比。进一步地，我们采用射线投射一致性检验来区分动态点与静态点。最后，通过空间一致性验证步骤优化标签分类，生成残存动态特征更少、过度移除现象更轻的静态地图。我们在SemanticKITTI数据集和自建的复杂数据集上进行了定性与定量评估，实验结果表明该方法能够持续生成稳定的静态地图。

title: Curvature-Aware Captioning:Leveraging Geodesic Attention for 3D Scene Understanding
summary:
Accurate 3D scene description is fundamental to robotic navigation and augmented reality, yet current dense captioning methods face significant limitations in processing sparse point cloud data. %
Existing approaches that apply Euclidean embedding spaces struggle to simultaneously preserve fine-grained local geometric details and model exponentially growing global semantic hierarchies, leading to either inaccurate localization or disjointed, shallow scene descriptions. %
In this work, we propose a novel \textbf{\textsc{Curvature-Aware Captioning}} framework, integrating novel non-Euclidean geodesic attention mechanisms, to resolve the localization-contextualization conflict. %
Specifically, self-attention within Oblique space enforces dimensional homogeneity while establishing long-range dependencies. Bidirectional geodesic cross-attention within Lorentz space models hierarchical semantic relationships across scene instances, enabling simultaneous precision in object localization and coherence in scene descriptions. %
Theoretical analysis confirms that the curvature complementarity between the Oblique manifold and Lorentz hyperboloid resolves the Euclidean-hyperbolic conflict, ensuring feature stability via isotropic optimization while preserving inherent hierarchical relationships. Extensive experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with significant gains in both localization accuracy and descriptive richness.
tldr: Proposes a curvature-aware 3D dense captioning framework using non-Euclidean geodesic attention mechanisms to improve object localization and descriptive coherence in sparse point clouds.
tldr_zh: 提出一种曲率感知的3D密集描述框架，利用非欧几里得测地注意力机制，在稀疏点云数据中改善物体定位和场景描述的连贯性。
summary_zh: 精确的三维场景描述是机器人导航与增强现实应用的基础，但当前密集标注方法在处理稀疏点云数据时面临显著局限。现有基于欧氏嵌入空间的方法难以同时保留细粒度局部几何细节并建模指数级增长的全局语义层次，导致定位不准确或场景描述脱节且浅层。本研究提出一种新颖的**曲率感知标注**框架，通过整合非欧几里得测地注意力机制来解决定位与语境化的冲突。具体而言，斜流形空间内的自注意力机制在建立长程依赖关系的同时保持维度同质性；洛伦兹空间内的双向测地交叉注意力建模跨场景实例的层次化语义关联，实现了对象定位精度与场景描述连贯性的同步提升。理论分析证实，斜流形与双曲空间之间的曲率互补性解决了欧几里得-双曲空间的冲突，通过各向同性优化确保特征稳定性，同时保留固有的层次关系。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在定位精度与描述丰富性方面均取得显著提升，达到当前最优性能。

title: Terminal Matters: Kinodynamic Planning with a Terminal Cost and Learned Uncertainty in Belief State-Cost Space
summary: In many real-world robotic tasks, robots must generate dynamically feasible motions that reliably reach desired goals even under uncertainty. Yet existing sampling-based kinodynamic planners typically optimize accumulated trajectory costs and treat goal reaching as a feasibility check, rather than explicitly optimizing terminal-state quality, such as goal preference or goal-reaching reliability. In this work, we introduce a terminal-cost formulation for kinodynamic planning that allows terminal-state quality to be optimized alongside accumulated trajectory cost. We prove that AO-RRT, an asymptotically optimal kinodynamic planner, preserves its asymptotic optimality under this augmented objective. We further extend the formulation to belief space and prove that minimizing the Wasserstein distance between the terminal belief and the goal improves a lower bound on the probability of reaching the goal region. The resulting planner, KiTe, uses this terminal-cost objective to encode goal preferences and improve reliability under uncertainty. To support systems without analytical uncertainty models, we learn dynamics and process uncertainty directly from data and integrate the learned belief dynamics into planning. Experiments on Flappy Bird, Car Parking, and Planar Pushing show that KiTe consistently improves goal-reaching success under uncertainty. Real-world Planar Pushing experiments further demonstrate that KiTe can plan effectively with learned dynamics and uncertainty. Source code is available at https://github.com/elpis-lab/KiTe.
tldr: This paper introduces a terminal-cost formulation for kinodynamic planning to optimize terminal-state quality under uncertainty, extends it to belief space, and integrates learned dynamics and uncertainty models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于运动动力学规划的终端代价公式，以优化不确定情况下的终端状态质量，将其扩展到信念空间，并集成了学习到的动力学和不确定性模型。

title: Omni-scale Learning-based Sequential Decision Framework for Order Fulfillment of Tote-handling Robotic Systems
summary: Driven by the rapid expansion of e-commerce and small-batch production, the size of the intralogistics load unit of finished goods, semi-finished goods and raw materials is steadily shrinking. Totes are gradually replacing pallets as the primary handling and storage container. This shift has propelled tote-handling robotic systems to the forefront of automation order fulfillment centers. The order-fulfillment decisions of tote-handling robotic systems share a common order-tote-robot sequential decision-making nature. Existing studies primarily focus on decision mechanisms tailored to particular systems, making it difficult to generalize or transfer them to other contexts. We propose an Omni-scale Learning-based Sequential Decision Framework for Order Fulfillment of Tote-handling Robotic Systems (OLSF-TRS), a generalized and scalable sequential decision framework that combines structured combinatorial optimization with multi-agent reinforcement learning to coordinate order,tote, and robot decisions. On small-scale tote-handling robotic systems, OLSF-TRS achieves near-optimal performance with average optimality gaps below 3.5% across two distinct system configurations. In large-scale scenarios, OLSF-TRS consistently outperforms heuristic baselines across two different system types, reducing total tote movements by 8-12% and over 30% compared to SOTA rule-based approaches, while maintaining real-time responsiveness. These improvements translate into tangible operational benefits, including cost reduction, lower energy consumption, and enhanced throughput stability. The proposed framework delivers an efficient and unified order fulfillment decision-making framework for widely deployed tote-handling robotic systems,supporting high-quality order fulfillment in both e-commerce and industrial logistics sectors.
tldr: The paper proposes an omni-scale learning-based sequential decision framework for order fulfillment in tote-handling robotic systems, combining structured combinatorial optimization with multi-agent reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种面向料箱搬运机器人系统订单履行的全尺度学习序贯决策框架，结合了结构化组合优化与多智能体强化学习。

title: Quantile-Coupled Flow Matching for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
summary: Unlike standard expected-return Reinforcement Learning (RL), Distributional RL (DRL) models the full return distribution, making it better-suited for uncertainty-aware and risk-sensitive decision-making. Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) critics have recently attracted attention for modelling continuous, multi-modal return distributions. Despite this interest, there remains a substantial metric mismatch: DRL theory relies on the distributional Bellman operator being contractive in the $p$-Wasserstein distance, yet existing CFM critics are trained with arbitrary source-target couplings, so their flow-matching losses are not Wasserstein-aligned surrogates for matching Bellman target return distributions. In this work, we address this mismatch by proposing FlowIQN, a CFM critic that sorts source and Bellman target samples within each mini-batch to approximate the monotone optimal transport coupling, replacing arbitrary pairings with quantile-aligned flow paths. We prove that the loss of our quantile-coupled CFM critic yields a Wasserstein-aligned approximate projection compatible with the foundations of DRL. To our knowledge, FlowIQN is the first flow-matching distributional critic with an explicit Wasserstein-aligned projection guarantee. We further extend FlowIQN with shortcut models for efficient inference. Empirical results show that FlowIQN improves Wasserstein return-distribution accuracy over other CFM critics. It also yields competitive performance on offline RL benchmarks across multiple policy extraction methods, providing a theoretically grounded CFM critic that is readily compatible with DRL pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ori-goals/flowIQN.
tldr: Proposes FlowIQN, a conditional flow matching distributional RL critic that uses quantile coupling to align with Wasserstein distance, improving theoretical grounding and performance on offline RL benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出FlowIQN，一种使用分位数耦合来与Wasserstein距离对齐的条件流匹配分布强化学习评价器，改善了理论依据并在离线RL基准测试中提升了性能。

title: Done, But Not Sure: Disentangling World Completion from Self-Termination in Embodied Agents
summary: Standard embodied evaluations do not independently score whether an agent correctly commits to task completion at episode closure, a capacity we call terminal commitment. Behaviorally distinct failures--never completing the task, completing it but failing to stop, and reporting success without sufficient evidence--collapse into the same benchmark failure. We introduce VIGIL, an evaluation framework that makes terminal commitment independently measurable. Under VIGIL's default protocol, agents observe only egocentric RGB, receive no action-success signals, and must end each episode with a semantic report checked deterministically against hidden world state. This yields two separate scores: world-state completion (W) and benchmark success (B), where B additionally requires a correct terminal report. This decoupling makes four outcome categories distinguishable: missed execution, post-attainment drift, unsupported commitment, and verified success. Across 20 models on 1,000 frozen episodes, systems with comparable W differ by up to 19.7 pp in B: one model converts achieved states into correct reports, while another with near-identical execution drifts past the goal without closing. An action-feedback intervention further tests the separation: execution-oriented signals improve W broadly, yet commitment failures persist in models that do not already ground terminal reports in the achieved state. VIGIL provides a protocol that makes terminal commitment independently visible and scorable.
tldr: The paper introduces VIGIL, an evaluation framework that decouples and independently scores an embodied agent's ability to complete a task (world-state completion) from its ability to correctly commit to task termination with a semantic report (terminal commitment).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VIGIL评估框架，将具身智能体完成任务的能力（世界状态完成）与正确提交任务终止语义报告的能力（终端承诺）解耦并独立评分。

title: Probing the Impact of Scale on Data-Efficient, Generalist Transformer World Models for Atari
summary: Developing generalist systems that retain human-like data efficiency is a central challenge. While world models (WMs) offer a promising path, existing research often conflates architectural mechanisms with the independent impact of model \emph{scale}. In this work, we use a minimalist transformer world model to analyze scaling behaviors on the Atari 100k benchmark, using fixed offline datasets derived from a presupposed expert policy. Our results reveal that environments fundamentally fall into distinct scaling regimes, even when constrained by identical offline data budgets and model capacities. For individual tasks, some environments naturally allow models to pass the interpolation threshold, yielding monotonic improvements in the overparameterized regime, while others remain trapped in the classical regime, where larger world models degrade fidelity. In the unified setting, i.e., a single transformer trained on a suite of 26 Atari environments, we uncover that joint training stabilizes scaling dynamics, ensuring monotonic gains across all environments, regardless of their distinct inherent scaling regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that improved fidelity translates directly to downstream control, with policies learned entirely within the simulated dynamics achieving a median expert-random-normalized score of 0.770. Our findings suggest that future progress lies as much in precise scaling strategies as in architectural innovation.
tldr: This paper analyzes how model scaling affects transformer world models for Atari, showing environments have distinct scaling regimes and that joint training across games stabilizes scaling for improved world model fidelity and downstream control.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了模型规模对Atari Transformer世界模型的影响，发现不同环境具有不同的缩放规律，跨游戏联合训练能稳定缩放，提升世界模型保真度及下游控制性能。

title: Cross-Sample Relational Fusion: Unifying Domain Generalization and Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) requires a learning system to learn new classes while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, in real-world scenarios such as autonomous driving, a system trained on urban roads in sunny weather may later need to operate in rural or highway environments with different traffic patterns and weather conditions. This requires the model not only to overcome catastrophic forgetting, but also to effectively handle domain shifts. In this paper, we propose CrOss-sample Relational Fusion (CORF), a unified framework to address domain shift and catastrophic forgetting simultaneously. To enhance generalizability, we perform selective refinement of training samples by leveraging spatial contribution maps to highlight semantically informative regions. Furthermore, we incorporate predictive confidence to adaptively weigh samples, thereby facilitating the learning of domain-agnostic representations. To alleviate forgetting, we propose a cascaded distillation framework that captures cross-sample relational dependencies across multiple feature hierarchies, enabling multi-grained knowledge transfer from previous tasks. CORF can be seamlessly integrated into existing CIL algorithms to enhance their generalizability, achieving competitive performance across various benchmark datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/TMM26-CORF .
tldr: The paper proposes a unified framework called CORF to address domain shift and catastrophic forgetting simultaneously in class-incremental learning, with an example application in autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个名为 CORF 的统一框架，旨在同时处理域偏移和灾难性遗忘，并以自动驾驶为例进行应用。

title: Model-Reference Adaptive Flight Control of the 95-mg Bee++
summary: We introduce a model-reference adaptive control (MRAC) architecture for high-performance positional tracking of the Bee++, a 95-mg insect-scale flapping-wing aerial vehicle. The suitability, functionality, and high performance of the proposed approach are demonstrated using data from real-time flight experiments.
tldr: A model-reference adaptive control (MRAC) architecture is proposed for high-performance positional tracking of the 95-mg Bee++ flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle, validated with real-time flight experiments.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种模型参考自适应控制（MRAC）架构，用于对95毫克的Bee++扑翼微型飞行器进行高性能位置跟踪，并通过实时飞行实验验证了其性能。

title: Zero-shot Imitation Learning by Latent Topology Mapping
summary: Imitation learning is effective for training agents when expert demonstrations are available, but collecting demonstrations for every complex task in an environment is costly. We study the long-horizon, goal-conditioned setting where a fixed demonstration dataset contains useful behavior, but not complete examples for every task the agent must solve. Existing imitation learning methods can learn strong policies from demonstrations, but when solving long-horizon tasks, small errors accumulate over long primitive-action trajectories and make zero-shot adaptation to new tasks unreliable. We introduce Zero-shot Agents from Latent Topologies (ZALT), an imitation-learning method that solves unseen start-goal tasks beyond those demonstrated during training. ZALT identifies latent hub states where trajectories converge or diverge, learns policies and a dynamics model over hub-to-hub transitions, and plans over the hub topology to complete new tasks. This topology makes demonstrated behaviors explicitly composable while compressing long tasks into shorter sequences of abstract transitions -- combined, these enable ZALT to perform zero-shot adaptation. In a complex 3D maze environment, ZALT achieves 55% zero-shot success on unseen tasks, compared to 6% for the strongest baseline.
tldr: The paper introduces ZALT, a zero-shot imitation learning method that identifies latent hub states in demonstrations, learns policies and dynamics over hub transitions, and plans over the hub topology to solve unseen long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ZALT，一种零样本模仿学习方法，通过识别演示中的潜在枢纽状态，学习枢纽间转移的策略和动态模型，并在枢纽拓扑上规划以解决未见过的长视野任务。

title: SYNCR: A Cross-Video Reasoning Benchmark with Synthetic Grounding
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in single-video understanding, yet their ability to reason across multiple independent video streams remains poorly understood. Existing multi-video benchmarks rely largely on human-annotated real-world footage, limiting the precision of spatial, temporal, and physical ground truth and making it difficult to diagnose model failures. We introduce SYNCR, a controlled synthetic benchmark for cross-video reasoning with programmatically verified grounding. Built using Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER simulator engines, SYNCR contains 8,163 multi-video question-answer pairs grounded in 9,650 unique videos. It evaluates MLLMs across eight tasks spanning four diagnostic pillars: Temporal Alignment, Spatial Tracking, Comparative Reasoning, and Holistic Synthesis.
  Our zero-shot evaluation of leading open- and closed-weight MLLMs reveals a substantial gap between current models and humans: the best model achieves only 52.5% average accuracy, compared to an 89.5% human baseline. Models perform relatively well on temporal ordering but struggle with precise physical and spatial reasoning, with the best model reaching only 26.0% accuracy on Kinematic Comparison. We further find that parameter scaling and reasoning-specialized post-training improve temporal alignment capabilities, but do not reliably address fine-grained physical tracking or global spatial synthesis. Finally, an exploratory sim-to-real correlation analysis suggests that several SYNCR tasks track model-level trends on real-world multi-video benchmarks, while also exposing reasoning capabilities underrepresented by existing evaluations. Code available at https://github.com/SaraGhazanfari/SYNCR.
tldr: This paper introduces SYNCR, a synthetic cross-video reasoning benchmark for MLLMs with programmatically verified grounding, built using robotic simulators, to diagnose model failures on spatial, temporal, and physical reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 SYNCR，一个用于 MLLM 的合成跨视频推理基准，使用机器人模拟器构建，具有程序化验证的标注，用于诊断模型在空间、时间和物理推理任务上的失败。

title: Smoothing Out the Edges: Continuous-Time Estimation with Gaussian Process Motion Priors on Factor Graphs
summary: Continuous-time state estimation is gaining in popularity due to its abilities to provide smooth solutions, handle asynchronous sensors, and interpolate between data points. While there are two main paradigms, parametric (e.g., temporal basis functions, splines) and nonparametric (Gaussian processes), the latter has seen less adoption despite its technical advantages and relative ease of implementation. In this article, we seek to rectify this situation by providing a new simplified explanation of GP continuous-time estimation rooted in the language of factor graphs, which have become the de facto estimation paradigm in much of robotics. To simplify onboarding, we also provide three working examples implemented in the popular GTSAM estimation framework.
tldr: This paper provides a simplified explanation of Gaussian process continuous-time estimation using factor graphs and includes three working examples in GTSAM.
tldr_zh: 本文使用因子图提供了一种高斯过程连续时间估计的简化解释，并在GTSAM中包含了三个工作示例。

title: Automated Robotic Moisture Monitoring in Agricultural Fields
summary: Monitoring moisture level of land in a large-scale plantation is tedious. The main objective of this project is to use a robotic kit in collaboration with the on-field moisture sensor circuits, thereby creating an efficient and economical moisture monitoring system. A large agriculture field is divided into smaller grids. Each grid is placed with a moisture sensor. Whenever a sensor reports the soil to be dry, the robot goes to the concerned field for inspection. The path to the concerned field is found by applying Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm on the aerial image of the field. Then the total moisture content of the field is calculated by the robot using suitable image processing algorithms and reported accordingly. For developing and testing this work, a small study field was set up above which a camera was mounted at an appropriate height to capture its aerial view. Thus a prototype for an automated system of monitoring agricultural fields' moisture has been developed through this work.
tldr: This paper develops an automated robotic system for agricultural field moisture monitoring, using a mobile robot to inspect sensor-triggered dry zones and applying Dijkstra's algorithm for path planning and image processing for moisture estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文开发了一个用于农田湿度监测的自动化机器人系统，通过移动机器人检查传感器触发的干燥区域，应用Dijkstra算法进行路径规划，并利用图像处理技术估算湿度。

title: VISTA: A Benchmark for Real-Time Video Streaming under Network Impairments in Surgical Teleoperation
summary: Real-time video streaming is crucial in surgical teleoperation, yet reproducible evaluation under realistic network impairments remains limited. This paper presents VISTA, a benchmark designed to study how impairments along the forward video path affect received video quality, temporal continuity, and human task performance. VISTA employs Linux Traffic Control with NetEm and a Gilbert-Elliott loss model to emulate five network conditions: Hospital LAN, 5G Urban, 4G Rural, LEO Satellite, and GEO Satellite. The benchmark integrates a standardised peg transfer task with synchronized measurements of network quality of service (QoS), objective video quality (PSNR, SSIM, and VMAF), and temporal continuity through freeze rate, while maintaining a stable reverse control channel. Across 375 experimental trials, network degradation substantially reduced teleoperation performance: success rate decreased from 97% in Hospital LAN to 79% in 5G Urban, 35% in 4G Rural, 71% in LEO Satellite, and 12% in GEO Satellite, while mean task completion time for successful trials increased from 80 s in Hospital LAN to 117 s in 5G Urban, 211 s in 4G Rural, 152 s in LEO Satellite, and 255 s in GEO Satellite. These findings show that network impairments have a direct impact on task completion and success in surgical teleoperation, and provide a reproducible basis for evaluating teleoperation video under realistic network constraints. Source code available at https://github.com/Dzxx623/VISTA.
tldr: VISTA is a benchmark for reproducible evaluation of real-time video streaming under network impairments in surgical teleoperation, measuring impact on video quality and human task performance.
tldr_zh: VISTA是一个用于评估手术遥操作中网络损伤下实时视频流传输的基准，衡量其对视频质量和任务性能的影响。

title: AssemPlanner: A Multi-Agent Based Task Planning Framework for Flexible Assembly System
summary: In flexible assembly systems, existing task planning methods require a time-consuming configuration process by multiple experts to establish a production line for a new product. To address this challenge, we propose a multi-agent based task planning framework for flexible assembly systems, denoted as AssemPlanner. It takes tasks described in natural language as input, which are then converted into actionable sequential production operations. It comprises several specialized agents, including SchedAgent , KnowledgeAgent, LineBalanceAgent, and a scene graph. Within the proposed framework, SchedAgent serves as the central reasoning engine. Departing from traditional static pipelines, AssemPlanner utilizes a ReAct-based SchedAgent to adaptively adjust actions via multi-agent feedback. By observing the feedback from KnowledgeAgent, LineBalanceAgent, and the scene graph, it autonomously resolves complex industrial process constraints. To facilitate reproducibility, all code and datasets are released at https://github.com/chz332/Assemplanner.
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-agent framework for industrial task planning, using a ReAct-based scheduling agent to adaptively generate assembly sequences from natural language task descriptions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于工业任务规划的多智能体框架，使用基于ReAct的调度智能体，从自然语言任务描述中自适应地生成装配序列。

title: HULK: Large-scale Hierarchical Coordination under Continual and Uncertain Temporal Tasks
summary: Multi-agent systems can be extremely efficient when working concurrently and collaboratively, e.g., for delivery, surveillance, search and rescue.
